ITEM 1 | Halved strawberry-like pieces, bright red flesh with lighter pinkish-white core and slightly glossy, moist surface; a few pieces are sliced in half showing cut faces, clustered in the upper portion of a white square plate, roughly 8 cm long per piece | 45
ITEM 2 | Whole and halved strawberry pieces, deep red with some pale tips and small seed dots on surface, moist and firm-looking, arranged in a loose cluster at upper edge of plate, each piece about 4 to 5 cm across | 40
ITEM 3 | Small dark blue-black round berries, smooth glossy skin with slight bloom, about 1 cm diameter each, scattered in a short line near the strawberry cluster on the upper right of plate | 8
ITEM 4 | Faint pinkish-red smear or juice residue, thin and watery, spread lightly on the white plate surface beneath and between the fruit pieces | 3
